thread:
ezra: Quick thank-you thread for Pri and Mohammed — they rescued the all-hands print queue and refilled the cookie jar after the call. Major saved demo vibes :cookie: :raised_hands:
pri: Printer was in a mood. Replaced toner, cleared a paper jam, and realigned the tray. Also put a spare USB-C cable back in the AV box (label suggestion: "AV spares") :wrench: :printer:
mohammed: Found a stuck job named "all-hands-final-final.pdf" that was blocking the queue. Ran `lpstat -l` to see the queue then removed the offending job with `lprm` — printer calmed down immediately :computer: :white_check_mark:
carla: Pri & Mohammed = heroes. Cookies lasted .7 of a meeting. Also seconding the AV spares label, and maybe a small note by the printer that says "Check toner/tray before panic" :memo: :coffee:
jade: Tiny poll: next pastry run — chocolate chip (:chocolate_chip:) or snickerdoodle (:cinnamon_roll:)? React with the emoji and I'll order the winner tomorrow morning :shopping_cart:
ops-bot: Office event recorded: print-queue-rescue by pri,mohammed at 2026-03-23T08:12Z (ticket PR-214). Actions: toner replaced, stuck print job removed, spare cable returned to AV box, snack jar refilled. Reactions: :thumbsup: x6 :clipboard:
ezra: Thank you again both. Coffee on me next team coffee run to make up for the snack tax :coffee:
mohammed: Will paste the exact command in thread for anyone who wants it: `lpstat -o | awk '/all-hands-final-final.pdf/ {print $1}' | xargs -r lprm` — use with care :grimacing:
